overnight.rule: On-street parking is not allowed between 1 a.m. and 6 a.m. unless a sign says otherwise or you have a valid exemption or Citywide On-Street Residential Parking Permit.

downtown.weekdayPaid: Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.
downtown.weekdayFree: Monday to Friday after 6 p.m. until 9 a.m.
downtown.saturday: Pay parking is required 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. in Lots 1, 4 and 5 and at on-street meters, with a three-hour maximum on-street. Other municipal lots and the Waterfront Parking Garage at 414 Locust Street are free.
downtown.sundayHoliday: Downtown on-street spaces, municipal lots and the Waterfront Parking Garage are free on Sundays and holidays.
downtown.waterfrontException: The waterfront lots at 1286 Lakeshore Road do not provide free holiday parking.

snow.rule: During a declared snow event, on-street parking is prohibited until the City declares the event over. Permits and exemptions are not valid. Overnight parking in municipal lots between 1 a.m. and 6 a.m. is not permitted during and after a snow event.
